description: This file defines a custom JSP tag class 'StoreFooterlTag' used to generate footer content for a store, including store name and operational years.

classes.name: StoreFooterlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag for rendering store footer information, including store name and operational years, based on request attributes.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates and outputs the store footer content including store name and operational years.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Handles tag end processing, simply returns EVAL_PAGE to evaluate the rest of the page.
